Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
